meta.database_name: NL Injury Tracker — Community MLB Injury Database
meta.description: Community-maintained MLB injury database tracking National League stars. Data sourced from official MLB, team reporters, and verified beat reporters.

players.name: Ronald Acuña Jr.

types: Left hamstring strain (2nd occurrence this season)
current_injury.mechanism: Hamstring: strained running to first base. Fibula: non-displaced fracture in Spring Training.
current_injury.details: Grade 1 left hamstring strain on 10-day IL June 10. FCL rehab since July 2025. Grand slam in 3rd FCL rehab game (423 ft, 112.8 mph exit velocity). Went 0-for-3 with walk and 5 RBIs as DH only. Left fibula non-displaced fracture on 60-day IL since March 2026. Transferred to Gwinnett for rehab July 17, target July 18-19.

players.notes: First injury-shortened season since 2023 torn ACL. Rehab Gate watch critical: BP → live pitching → straight-line running → cutting → MiLB rehab → MLB activation. Guardian Ha-Seong Kim also in Gwinnett rehab.

latest_update.event: To Gwinnett for rehab July 17. Grand slam in 3rd FCL rehab game. Cutting drills NOT cleared.

players.name: Mookie Betts

current_injury.mechanism: Back stiffness — not from specific incident. Wrist soreness resolved. Residual fatigue from severe viral illness (late July 2025 — ~25 lbs weight loss).
current_injury.details: Out 3+ games as of July 13 for back stiffness. NOT expected on IL for back or wrist. Manager Roberts: 'He's feeling a little better. Right now we're in a good spot — we're just managing day-to-day.' 7-game hitting streak (.355 avg over last 15). Weight stabilizing at ~150 lbs.
current_injury.weight_loss: ~25 lbs during late July 2025 viral illness

rehab_timeline.viral_care: New medication; full workout; weight stabilizing; 'turned a corner' per Roberts

players.notes: Most tumultuous recent stretch in memory. All major injuries resolved. No IL expected. 7-game hit streak confirms full recovery. Lineup: Freeman at 2nd, Betts at 3rd, Tucker at 4th, Ohtani at 1st.

latest_update.event: Back stiffness day-to-day; out 3+ games. 7-game hit streak. No IL expected.

players.name: Freddie Freeman
players.status: Active & Healthy; chronic ankle managed with load management

types: Chronic left ankle (managed via load management)
current_injury.mechanism: Neck stinger: neck → right shoulder vs. Reds. Chronic ankle: from prior sprains managed via load management. March 2025 rib/scar tissue also re-aggravated during BP for Tokyo opener.
current_injury.details: No acute injury currently preventing play. Neck stinger fully resolved. Chronic left ankle managed with load management and occasional treatment. No expected games missed. Out Wednesday vs Reds with neck stinger; returned Friday with no lingering effects.
current_injury.management: Load management with rest days; occasional flare-ups monitored

rehab_timeline.expected_return: N/A — Currently active and playing regularly
rehab_timeline.ankle_management: Ongoing with load management; occasional flare-ups

injury_history.return_status: Returned; played through postseason, WS MVP

players.notes: Chronic ankle issues (right debridement Dec 2024, left sprain Jun 2025) require ongoing load management. Walk-Off Grand Slam in 2024 WS legend despite injuries. Freeman is the most durable of the three tracked NL stars. 2025: 30 SB in 300 ABs, 25.9% walk rate, MLB leader in softball grounds.

latest_update.event: Out vs Reds Wednesday with neck stinger. Returned Friday. Chronic ankle managed via load management.
